#!/bin/sh
set -e
goal="Implement gitignore and cleanup"
echo "Plan:"
echo "1. Update the .gitignore file to exclude only specific files from root."
echo "2. Delete the already added files from git to ensure modifications are ignored."
echo "3. Confirm changes."

# Step 1: Update .gitignore
cat > .gitignore << 'EOF'
/secret.sh
/node_modules/
/tmp/
/prompt.yaml
/prompt.md
/change.sh
EOF

# Step 2: Remove the files from git
git rm --cached ./prompt.yaml
git rm --cached ./prompt.md
git rm --cached ./change.sh

# Step 3: Confirm changes
echo "\033[32mDone: $goal\033[0m\n"

#!/bin/sh
set -e
goal="Implement gitignore and cleanup"
echo "Plan:"
echo "1. Update the .gitignore file to exclude only specific files from root."
echo "2. Forcefully remove the already added files from git to ensure modifications are ignored."
echo "3. Confirm changes."

# Step 1: Update .gitignore
cat > .gitignore << 'EOF'
/secret.sh
/node_modules/
/tmp/
/prompt.yaml
/prompt.md
/change.sh
EOF

# Step 2: Forcefully remove the files from git
git rm -f --cached ./prompt.yaml
git rm -f --cached ./prompt.md
git rm -f --cached ./change.sh

# Step 3: Confirm changes
echo "\033[32mDone: $goal\033[0m\n"
